comparison.objective: Move a lamp closer before placing its attached plug in a tray without pulling the cord dangerously; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Manage a tethered object and articulated cord, reposition the lamp, and place the plug versus fine hex engagement, collar adjustment, socket reacquisition, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Lamp must remain upright and undamaged, plug end in the tray, cord not over-tensioned or detached, and hands released. Candidate instead requires retained adjustment and bounded repeated impacts.
comparison.reason: Tether management and safe plug delivery test different mechanics from shock-absorber commissioning.
